issues.title: [🐞]: SelectableContainerContent does not properly implement equals/hashcode, causing quivers not being able to be extracted from Refined Storage
issues.body:
### Before Continuing:

- [x] Check you are using the latest version of the mods and its dependencies
- [x] Always include a latest.log if you are crashing
- [x] Remove mod that enhances Minecraft: Optifine, Sodium, others. The issue persists.
- [x] If you are unsure which mod is the culprit.
Disable all of your mods and enable them 1-2 mods each time to isolate the culprit
- [x] Confirm that there is no existing issue with a similar description submitted in the list of issues.

### Version

1.21.1-NEOFORGE

### Supplementaries Version

supplementaries-1.21-3.1.3-neoforge

### Moonlight Lib Version

moonlight-1.21-2.18.5-neoforge

### Describe Issue

Hi there,

`SelectableContainerContent` does not return a proper equals/hashcode. `ItemStack` does not provide an equals/hashcode, so the `NonNullList<ItemStack>` equals/hashcode does not do what is expected.

Why is this a problem? When inserting quivers from this mod in Refined Storage, and when trying to extract them from a Grid, Refined Storage will send an example stack from the client to the server. It will then perform an exact match for this stack in the server repository.

**However, if the equals/hashcode of the component map is not stable, this extraction will fail.**

Fix:
* The stack list needs to be hashed with `ItemStack.hashStackList()` and equality-tested with `ItemStack.listMatches()`
* Basically, if you have stacks in your component and you're not doing what vanilla's `ItemContainerContents` does, then your component is broken.

supplementaries-1.20-3.1.20 Forge

moonlight-1.20-2.13.72-forge

### Describe Issue

I... have been scouring the internet for this for a WEEK.
I had to disassemble my modpack mod by mod, till I eventually worked backwards to this...

Forge 47.4.0
Minecraft 1.20.1
LWJGL 3 3.3.1

I rolled back one by one from 1.11.12 to 1.11.5 all of these versions cause the issue.
it appears the interaction is with Forgeified Fabric API and Supplementaries 1.20-3.1.20 for forge. while having create 6.0.2 or 6.0.3 installed. Trying to roll back with an older version of Supplementaries 1.20-3.1.18 or 1.20-3.1.17 your game will crash

This is more than just Supplementaries, if you have both mods installed it ruins all searches with the craft book or JEI. To verify, try searching for non Supplementaries starting with C like "Campfire" these recipies are also missing.

If you remove Forgified Fabric API, you will be able to search for recipes again.
If you remove Create, you can use Forgeified Fabric API and Supplementaries 1.20-3.1.20 including older versions up to 1.20-3.1.17 (didn't test farther than that)
If you remove Supplementaries and use Create 6.0.3 the interaction goes away (you can search for campfire)

To sum up, the interaction of Forgeified Fabric API 1.11.12 to 1.11.5 with both Supplementaries and Create installed causing recipes to stop working.

I'll spread this around, to see if someone in one of those 3 mods can figure out what happened.
I hope this helps someone <3

issues.body:

### Version

### Supplementaries Version

1.21-3.0.41-beta

### Moonlight Lib Version

1.21-2.17.36

### Describe Issue

# Bug Report: Stack Overflow Error When Loading Server with Cave Overhaul
## Description
When running Supplementaries with Cave Overhaul on NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.1, the server crashes on startup with a stack overflow error. The crash occurs during the creation of a fake test world by Supplementaries' FaucetBehaviorsManager, which triggers a recursive error in Cave Overhaul's noise generation code.
## Environment

Minecraft Version: 1.21.1
Mod Loader: NeoForge
Supplementaries Version: 1.21-3.0.41-beta
Moonlight Library Version: 1.21-2.17.36
Cave Overhaul Version: 1.3.3.1

## Error Details
The server crashes with a java.lang.StackOverflowError during startup. The stack trace shows a recursive call in the wftech.caveoverhaul.NoiseMaker.copyDF method, which is triggered when Supplementaries attempts to create a fake test world via the FakeLevelManager.
## Steps to Reproduce

Install NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.1
Install Supplementaries, Moonlight Library, and Cave Overhaul mods
Start the server
Server crashes before fully loading

## Crash Log
```md
Copyjava.lang.StackOverflowError: Exception in server tick loop
	at TRANSFORMER/caveoverhaul@1.3.3.1/wftech.caveoverhaul.NoiseMaker.copyDF(NoiseMaker.java:284) ~[caveoverhaul-nf-1.21.1-1.3.3.1.jar%23409!/:?] {re:mixin,re:classloading}
	at TRANSFORMER/caveoverhaul@1.3.3.1/wftech.caveoverhaul.NoiseMaker.copyDF(NoiseMaker.java:193) ~[caveoverhaul-nf-1.21.1-1.3.3.1.jar%23409!/:?] {re:mixin,re:classloading}
...
	at TRANSFORMER/supplementaries@1.21-3.0.41-beta/net.mehvahdjukaar.supplementaries.common.block.faucet.FaucetBehaviorsManager.reloadWithLevel(FaucetBehaviorsManager.java:124) ~[supplementaries-1.21-3.0.41-beta-neoforge.jar%23573!/:?] {re:classloading}
	at TRANSFORMER/supplementaries@1.21-3.0.41-beta/net.mehvahdjukaar.supplementaries.common.events.ServerEvents.onServerStart(ServerEvents.java:162) ~[supplementaries-1.21-3.0.41-beta-neoforge.jar%23573!/:?] {re:mixin,re:classloading}
	at TRANSFORMER/supplementaries@1.21-3.0.41-beta/net.mehvahdjukaar.supplementaries.common.events.neoforge.ServerEventsForge.onServerStart(ServerEventsForge.java:106) ~[supplementaries-1.21-3.0.41-beta-neoforge.jar%23573!/:?] {re:classloading}
```
## Attempted Solutions

Tried disabling faucets in the Supplementaries config file, but the crash still occurs
Removing Cave Overhaul resolves the issue, indicating a compatibility problem between the mods

## Suggested Solutions

Add a config option to disable the fake world creation/testing mechanism
Add compatibility detection for Cave Overhaul to skip the problematic initialization
Implement a more robust error handling when creating fake test worlds

## Additional Information
The crash appears to be caused by an interaction between Supplementaries' block testing system (which creates a fake world) and Cave Overhaul's world generation code. A config option to disable test world generation would be helpful for users experiencing similar issues with other world generation mods.

1.20.1-FORGE

supplementaries-1.20-3.1.12

### Moonlight Lib Version

moonlight-1.20-2.13.58-forge

### Describe Issue

There are three items that all share this behaviour when put in the Lunch Basked from Supplementaries:
- Potion Flask
- Enchanted Potion Flask: Extend Time
- Enchanted Potion Flask: Amplify
The way those items work is kind of similar to Basket, albeit just for potions: You can store up to 8 potions (all must be the same potions) and you may drink from it to gain that potions effect.
Potion Flask doesn't modify potions in any way, while Enchanted variants either extend stored potions duration or increase their level at the cost of their duration.

When those flask are put inside of the Lunch Basked, because they are drinkable items, they will be accepted into the basked, but I guess because technically we are holding Basked and not Flask itself, the code responsible for reducing the count on the Flask tries to do so on the Basked... which does nothing.
I did update to newest version of the Supplementaries and Moonlight to make sure it wasn't fixed but sadly it's not, thus me writting this bug report.
EDIT: fixed misswritting

### Describe Issue

I believe I narrowed down the issue I had earlier with long world load times. The higher the spawnradius gamemode is set at, the longer it takes to load into a world. I started with the default and ramped it up to my survival world's value of 50000 I was having issues with on the latest Supplementaries: 10, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900, 950, 999, 1000, 1500, 2000, 50000. Loading times were getting longer and longer until eventually I gave up waiting as I was already at 50 minutes of waiting to load on this minimal instance. Notice the time gap when `Changing view distance to 16, from 10` appears, and when I killed the instance in this log:
Latest Supplementaries Log: https://mclo.gs/ia0qoaD

Note that as I was ramping up the spawnradius, I was staying at the exact same spot in the world. Only the radius was being changed

Here on 2.8.17 and on a Vanilla instance with 50000 spawnradius set I load into the world almost instantly:
2.8.17 Supplementaries Log: https://mclo.gs/eyVehjz
Vanilla Instance Log: https://mclo.gs/AvIvyiE

It's not a big deal as I was setting a high spawnradius for a hardcore random spawn location. Was a more elegant solution than using a datapack that accomplished the same thing but in an ugly uncustomizable way. I'm just curious of what changed between version 2 and 3 of Supplementaries that causes load times to shoot up exponentially relative to the spawnradius (I tested every version above 2 and got the same issue).

**Steps to reproduce:**
- Generate a world with the gamerule spawnradius set to a high number (like 50000) or load into a default world and set the gamerule to that after it generated
- Log out and log back in
- Enjoy this screen forever:

issues.title: [🗃]:Have cannons throw throwable items
issues.body: Cannon should launch throwables, like tridents, as thrown projectiles. The cannon can launch arrows and modded projectiles, including the throwable bricks that Supplementaries adds. This feature should be extended to tridents and other such weapons like spears. An interesting note is that Quark's pickarang is thrown by the cannon, and the dispenser does not do this, so maybe look into that.

issues.title: [🗃]:custom globe textures
issues.body:
**Before continuing**
Be sure to read the mod wiki page to verify that your requested feature isn't already added. Pay particular attention to the *configuration* section

it would be cool if you could make custom globes by just having textures in a texture pack that have "globe_"
for example: making a texture called globe_mars would make it so that when you name a globe mars, the texture is applied to the globe, similar to how it works normally. i don't think it should require any other configuration besides maybe having to add something to a datapack, if that's possible.

issues.title: [🗃]: Rope arrow enhancement
issues.body: Rope arrows feel clunky to craft, especially with them not appearing in the recipe book. It would be a great QoL change if you could pick up ropes in your inventory by right clicking on top of them while holding a rope arrow, similar to how bundles work.

issues.title: [🗃]: Speakers can emit a specific sound during message/narration
issues.body:
Specify the sound and in kinds of `@namespace:sound;` pattern in speaker's string to enable it. A specific block can also make a sound along with the message such as heads (emits mob sound). Can be used on funny things like making ATOS in railway system.

There can be also minecarts with speaker, shapelessly crafted with cart and speaker, activated by activator track, and return speaker and minecart on broken.

issues.title: [🗃]: Fodder to be measurable with a comparator
issues.body: I guess the most intuitive thing would be that whenever some level of fodder is consumed, it will emit a redstone pulse measurable with a comparator, so it's easier to hook up a redstone circuit that will replenish it whenever it's empty

issues.title: [🗃]: Roped Stick
issues.body:
We have sticks. We have rope. We have so man other roped stuff. We should have roped sticks.
Think: FD's tomatoes growing up on roped sticks.

issues.title: [🐞]: Can't start fabric server with 1.21.1 supplementaries
issues.body:
### Before Continuing:

- [X] Check you are using the latest version of the mods and its dependencies
- [X] Always include a latest.log if you are crashing
- [X] Remove mod that enhances Minecraft: Optifine, Sodium, others. The issue persists.
- [X] If you are unsure which mod is the culprit.
Disable all of your mods and enable them 1-2 mods each time to isolate the culprit
- [X] Confirm that there is no existing issue with a similar description submitted in the list of issues.

### Version

1.21.1-FABRIC

### Supplementaries Version

supplementaries-1.21-3.0.20-beta-fabric

### Moonlight Lib Version

moonlight-1.21-2.17.5-fabric

### Issue Detail

### Issue Detail

The game crashes with the description "Exception ticking world" while a Flax Seed is planted.
This was tested in a full modpack initially, and then an environment with only Fabric API 0.108.0+1.21.1 (on Fabric 1.21.1 0.16.9), Moonlight 2.17.3 and Supplementaries 3.0.16. The attached logs are from this specific clean run test.

1) Plant a Flax Seed in Farmland
2) Wait for it to crash

issues.title: [🗃]:Large way signs
issues.body: These signs are 2 blocks long and 1 block high, containing multiple lines. Can be rotated horizontally (and clockwise, #1224 )

issues.title: [🗃]: Allow way signs to be rotated clockwise by wrench
issues.body: This makes way signs able to point upwards/downwards/other direction. Also a vertical turntable (and analog turntable if possible, #1223 ) can be added.

issues.title: [🗃]: Analog Turntable
issues.body: This turntable turns and forces the block above it to specific direction regarding the incoming redstone signal strength. Can rotate way signs or banners in 16 directions.

issues.title: Allow disabling of arrow preview feature in configs
issues.body: I already posted this as a bug, but I am requesting there please be a way to disable the arrow preview feature added in 3.0.0 in configs. This is because the game crashes with SAG weapons. Alteratively, there could be a way to make certain weapons such as SAG weapons exempt from this feature. I get that it is an issue with SAG, and I have already reported the issue on the SAG page, but checking the SimpleAnimatedGuns github page, it seems like no issues have been resolved there since 2023, and the last update to SimpleAnimatedGuns was in July. Also, even if they did make a fix, I am not using the main version of the mod but a fan retextured version, so the creator of that version would have to make an update as well, and I am not sure how to get into contact with the creator of that version. I am still going to post it there, but this whole process would most likely take months, so that I why I am asking here first.

### Version

1.20.1-FABRIC

### Supplementaries Version

1.20-3.1.2

### Moonlight Lib Version

fabric_1.20-2.13.21

### Issue Detail

I play on a 5 person Aternos server with my friends and 2 of them are having this issue.

Supplementaries blocks aren't showing up as what they're supposed to be, for example daub is now instead rendered as waterlogged placed blaze rods, stone tiles aren't showing up at all, lapis bricks turned into wooden braces and ash bricks are showing up as lapis brick walls.

![Skärmbild 2024-11-09 191935](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/42069a07-80d2-44ee-a7e2-51e6bef6d837)

none of the textures are broken in single player.

if you walk into them or stand on them it will barely let you move, a lot like stepping into an unloaded chunk.
for some reason it works perfectly fine for me but not for my friends.

before this it worked fine but now it's just broke.

I've tried every trick i know. restarting their computers, turning off all texture packs and performance mods, deleting the supplementaries config file and downgrading to old versions.
none of them worked.

I've looked everywhere and couldn't find anything like this so this is my last resort.

here's my friends Modrinth log.

I'm sorry if i forgot to include something, did something wrong or didn't do something really obvious, I'm not a much of a tech guy.

issues.title: Lunch Basket UI Change
issues.body:
The blue bar for the Lunch Basket is meant to signify the ratio of space a specific food item takes up in the Lunch Basket.

However, considering the bundle's use of that same blue bar to signify the ratio of the bundle filled, I think it would be more intuitive to use that bar to signify the ratio of the Lunch Basket filled? 

I nearly submitted a bug report because I had assumed it was the amount of space left in the Lunch Basket, before I caught on by testing out many different types of food in different amounts.

### Version

1.20.1-FABRIC

### Supplementaries Version

supplementaires-1.20-3.0.7

### Moonlight Lib Version

moonlight-fabric_1.20-2.13.21

### Issue Detail

Downloaded a client-side mod called Effective, which overhauls some audio and visual effects (most notably, it makes fireballs look prettier.)
After firing a fire charge out of a cannon, the game crashed. The crash logs dont mention Effective at all, but rather a rendering library that it uses called Lodestone. After a bit more testing, i can confirm that the crashes are caused by Lodestone instead of Effective. For larger mods that modify both the client and the server, that also require Lodestone (Namely, Malum, a magic mod that heavily uses the library), this could be a problem when paired with Supplementaries.

To replicate: Download the latest version of Lodestone (or a mod that uses it, like Effective or Malum). Then, put a fire charge into a cannon and fire. The cannon will fire, but nothing will come out. The game will crash and close soon afterwards.

I have only tested this on fabric, but it could apply to forge too, since Lodestone and Malum are mainly developed there.

- [X] Confirm that there is no existing issue with a similar description submitted in the list of issues.

### Version

1.20.1-FORGE

### Supplementaries Version

1.20-2.8.17

### Moonlight Lib Version

1.20-2.12.17

### Issue Detail

(Originally reported as FallingColors/HexMod#750)
Hex Casting's Place Block spell allows users to place a block without having said block in a hand slot. If a Cage is "placed" in this way, said cage will overwrite the item used by the player to cast the spell.
This is due to the fact that https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/blob/cba3bfae89a48afb35617336b173ce2f90ac1c17/common/src/main/java/net/mehvahdjukaar/supplementaries/common/items/AbstractMobContainerItem.java#L242-L244 overwrites the current hand's ItemStack.
More details are at the linked issue.

[❓]: How are soap "de-coloring" recipes implemented?
issues.body:
### Your Question

What tag is used to add recipes removing color from blocks using soap?

### Detail

A bit of a niche situation here, and I know very little about modding, so I'm probably missing something important.  I have a modpack using Chipped and Supplementaries together, and have noticed that many of the Chipped variants can be un-dyed from their colored to non-colored versions, but the type of block remains the same.  However, not all of the terracotta, concrete, and glazed terracotta variants seem to have this crafting recipe for some reason.

I would like to add the missing recipes so that each colored Chipped block in these sets can be "un-colored" using soap into the colorless variant of that type of block.  But I can't find any tag for these that would allow me to do so (e.g. "chipped:yellow_terracotta" would allows any yellow terracotta type for that recipe, not only one of the matching terracotta variant).  Perhaps if I understood how the soap recipes are generated, I could find a workaround.  I'd prefer not to add 15-16 recipes for every missing Chipped variant if possible, that doesn't see like a very neat solution.  Any help would be appreciated!

issues.title: [🐞]: Internet request will freeze the game for up to 20 seconds at startup
issues.body:
### Before Continuing:

- [X] Check you are using the latest version of the mods and its dependencies
- [X] Always include a latest.log if you are crashing
- [X] Remove mod that enhances Minecraft: Optifine, Sodium, others. The issue persists.
- [X] If you are unsure which mod is the culprit.
Disable all of your mods and enable them 1-2 mods each time to isolate the culprit

issues.title: Single 16 Color Redstone Lamp
issues.body:
The idea is simple, a redstone lamp that can be any color (basically an rgb led). The use would also be simple, depending on the signal intensity, a different color.

![ex](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a5bb5175-9ca9-4aa9-8428-03cdb02bce4c)
(An example, I think the order doesn't matter, the only logical thing is that black is 0 [off])

I've seen thousands of mods of individual lamps, one of each color type, but never a single one that can represent all the colors. I know this doesn't sound very "Minecraft" (especially when calling it RGB), but I imagined it on one of those giant screens they make in crazy redstone buildings and I saw incredible potential. A completely color screen inside Minecraft.

![ex0](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bebc740b-11d2-4723-9ba4-d1956eec3755)
(This but in color)

This mod along with quark seem to me to be the best of all and with the best aesthetics, it seems to me to be the one indicated to suggest a functional block.
I would like to know what you think or if it simply does not agree with minecraft or the rest of the mod. Thanks.



_Another lazy idea I had is that you could add colors to achieve infinite colors, kind of like beacons, but this wouldn't work since you couldn't power all the blocks with redstone. I just wanted to mention this other idea, maybe someone else can come up with something else._

issues.title: [Mod Compat] Controlify
issues.body:
https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/blob/1.20-split/fabric/src/main/java/net/mehvahdjukaar/supplementaries/common/events/fabric/ClientEventsFabric.java#L70

Here you check if the bind is pressed every frame, this is not the correct way to do this.
Like all binds in vanilla, it should be checked once per tick (when keys are updated).

This creates a problem for controller users, where Controlify relies on mods checking bindings correctly to be able to emulate presses. Checking GLFW directly for the key to be down does not and will not work.

This is a simple fix, move the above section of code into the `ClientTickEvents.END_CLIENT_TICK` event and call `KeyMapping#isPressed` normally!

issues.title: [🐞]: capture_blacklist tag not working as intended, wrong ids?
issues.body:
### Before Continuing:

- [X] Check you are using the latest version of the mods and its dependencies
- [X] Always include a latest.log if you are crashing
- [X] Remove mod that enhances Minecraft: Optifine, Sodium, others. The issue persists.
- [X] If you are unsure which mod is the culprit.
Disable all of your mods and enable them 1-2 mods each time to isolate the culprit
- [X] Confirm that there is no existing issue with a similar description submitted in the list of issues.

### Version

1.20.1-FORGE

### Supplementaries Version

supplementaries-1.20-2.8.15

### Moonlight Lib Version

moonlight-1.20-2.11.41-forge

### Issue Detail

`capture_blacklist.json` has a few entries for segmented mobs from Alex's Mobs. It is meant to prevent their capture, as it leads to issues because of the way the mobs are implemented.

Perhaps this used to work, but with the current version of Alex's Mobs (1.22.8) the blacklist is not effective. The blacklist itself is being applied, but the mob ids it includes do nothing.

I tested this by creating a modpack with just Alex's Mobs and Supplementaries (plus dependencies), enabling `cage_auto_detect` and trying to cage a cave centipede. The blacklist should prevent it from being captured, but it does not, so the centipede (or, rather, a segment) gets caged. I then replaced the id `alexsmobs:centipede` with `alexsmobs:centipede_body` and this time it did prevent capture of the centipede (segment).

I did a similar test with the anaconda. In this case, the blacklist does prevent the head (with id `alexsmobs:anaconda`) from being caged, but it does not do the same for the body, as the id for the body is `alexsmobs:anaconda_part`.

So, in short, I think the blacklist entries are not working as intended and need to be replaced with entries for each body segment of the respective mobs.

I believe the resulting json would look like this:
```
{
  "replace": false,
  "values": [
	{"id":"alexsmobs:centipede_head","required":false},
	{"id":"alexsmobs:centipede_body","required":false},
	{"id":"alexsmobs:centipede_tail","required":false},
	{"id":"alexsmobs:bone_serpent","required":false},
	{"id":"alexsmobs:bone_serpent_part","required":false},
	{"id":"alexsmobs:void_worm","required":false},
	{"id":"alexsmobs:void_worm_part","required":false},
	{"id":"alexsmobs:anaconda","required":false},
	{"id":"alexsmobs:anaconda_part","required":false},
	{"id":"alexsmobs:murmur","required":false},
	{"id":"alexsmobs:murmur_head","required":false}
  ]
}
```
I did not test every mob, but those are the mob ids I have been using on my modpack to prevent other capturing methods for these mobs.

What is the stuff function used for in Credits.java?

There is an unused function named "stuff" in Credits.java, which opens an URLConnection to a bit.ly address. issues.title: Block Tag for Soap Cleaning Blacklist
issues.body:
Soap can convert all kinds of colored blocks to their white variants. While there exists a config setting to add stuff, that is inacessible for other mods that want to blacklist blocks the soap can be used on. It would be nice having a block equivalent for it.

This is analog to #558, which added the item tag `supplementaries:soap_blacklist`, just for blocks instead of items this time around.

issues.body:
### Before Continuing:

- [X] Check you are using the latest version of the mods and its dependencies
- [X] Always include a latest.log if you are crashing
- [X] Remove mod that enhances Minecraft: Optifine, Sodium, others. The issue persists.
- [X] If you are unsure which mod is the culprit.
Disable all of your mods and enable them 1-2 mods each time to isolate the culprit
- [X] Confirm that there is no existing issue with a similar description submitted in the list of issues.

### Version

1.20.1-FABRIC

### Supplementaries Version

Supplementaries 1.20-2.7.30

### Moonlight Lib Version

Moonlight 1.20-2.9.3

### Issue Detail

Confession: we are not QUITE using the latest version of the mod, but I'm not able to change that in this server modpack. I guess we will update if it is known and fixed?
Also I checked the 4th checkbox because I'm fairly sure it's just your code, but to be honest I wouldn't be able to isolate it if I needed to since it didn't happen for me and I'm not positive if it's reproducible (though it does seem to be)

### Description

One of the players on a server I help operate is experiencing issues when viewing a chest that contains a vanilla skeleton skull. The first time they did it they crashed, and now they said it causes severe lag and (possibly, given they disconnected shortly after opening it) a second crash. The crash report says something about not being able to update a mesh's position because it is null, and your `SkullBlockRendererMixin` mixin is one of the mixins implicated by the crash report. 

### Questions

1. Is this a fixed issue already and I should just get our pack owner to update stuff, or was this (hopefully) helpful?
2. Does this have anything to do with Amendments? 
3. Come to think of it, I'm a bit confused about what we need to do with our pack moving forward, will Amendments add features we didn't already have or is it a straight split?

### Attachments

issues.title: [❓]: Pulling a rope still works?
issues.body:
### Your Question

How to pull a rope (with or without block attached)?

### Detail

Hello. Maybe I'm doing something wrong, but I can't pull a rope by right click with empty hand with shift as wiki says.
"The opposite is also true and can be achieved by shift clicking a rope with an empty hand. This will pull up the last attached block. Useful for wells".
I'm clicking on highest part, but any other parts also don't pull the rope. Extending a rope works fine, but if I want to just get it back - I can't. Lifting blocks up also dont' work, while moving them down works. But I saw a video with mod showcase and it worked.
Maybe it's because of Fabric, as description says - Fabric version might be missing some minor features as the mod is mainly for Forge ?

Minecraft 1.20.1, supplementaries-1.20-2.8.10-fabric, moonlight-1.20-2.11.9-fabric, fabric-api-0.92.0+1.20.1

issues.title: Hourglass and Gravisand compatibility
issues.body:
It's no secret that Supplementaries and Quark look great together and are the base for any Vanilla+ build. I think I have a great idea for compatibility that will complement the mechanics that already exist in them. You have a wonderful hourglass, while Quark offers interesting mechanics with gravitation sand. So let's combine them!

1. Gravity sand can be placed in an hourglass
2. The gravitational sand in the hourglass is moves in the opposite direction
3. Instead of starting with the minimum signal and gradually strengthening it, the gravitational sand in the hourglass will start with the strongest and weaken it as it moves upward

https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/assets/162970645/de30fd11-70c4-4679-8038-2300f5080151

This is just a small, pleasant addition. But it seems to me that this is the idea of Supplementaries

issues.title: [🐞]: Game crashes when attempting to put a bucket of fish into a jar
issues.body:
### Before Continuing:

- [X] Check you are using the latest version of the mods and its dependencies
- [X] Always include a latest.log if you are crashing
- [X] Remove mod that enhances Minecraft: Optifine, Sodium, others. The issue persists.
- [X] If you are unsure which mod is the culprit.
Disable all of your mods and enable them 1-2 mods each time to isolate the culprit
- [X] Confirm that there is no existing issue with a similar description submitted in the list of issues.

### Version

1.20.1-FABRIC

### Supplementaries Version

supplementaries-1.20-2.8.4-fabric.jar

### Moonlight Lib Version

moonlight-1.20-2.11.9-fabric.jar

### Issue Detail

Simply right-clicking a jar with any bucket of fish crashes the game, with a java.lang.UnsupportedOperationException: Unknown class type error. You can see that all my mods but Supplementaries and Moonlight are disabled.

Latest.log is attached, as well as a link to the crash log itself: [Crash log](https://mclo.gs/zd7hXRN)
[latest.log](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/files/14747989/latest.log)

issues.title: [🐞]: Speaker Block's "Narrator" and "Chat Message" functions are flipped
issues.body:
### Before Continuing:

- [X] Check you are using the latest version of the mods and its dependencies
- [X] Always include a latest.log if you are crashing
- [X] Remove mod that enhances Minecraft: Optifine, Sodium, others. The issue persists.
- [X] If you are unsure which mod is the culprit.
Disable all of your mods and enable them 1-2 mods each time to isolate the culprit
- [X] Confirm that there is no existing issue with a similar description submitted in the list of issues.

### Version

1.20.1-FABRIC

### Supplementaries Version

1.20-2.8.4

### Moonlight Lib Version

1.20-2.11.9

### Issue Detail

Speaker Blocks set to "Narrator Message" execute as chat messages, whilst Speaker Blocks set to "Chat Message" execute as audible narrated voice lines.

Additionally, setting the config option supplementaries-common.json > speaker_block > Narrator Enabled to "false" greys out the mode-setting button in Speaker Blocks' GUIs, rendering them unusable (I believe these issues are related).

I apologize, I did find some previously-existing issues apparently reporting this behavior/bug, but they were all closed and seemingly marked as resolved.

By the way, awesome mod! It's a joy to use and fits in with vanilla Minecraft seamlessly, huge kudos to you!

issues.title: Republish under more permissive license?
issues.body:
Hello,

I'm a new modder who recently found this mod and found it a great source of ideas and example code for developing my own works. I'm not so good at this yet, so instead of building it from scratch I was planning on trying to copy over a few pieces of work found here, tweaking them as needed, and giving full credit to this mod and its developers in my mod page/credits.

However, the current license reserves all rights to the works found here, so I'm very wary of even slightly using content found here. I'm wondering how the maintainers would feel about republishing this mod under a more permissive license, such as MIT or GNU? Or in lieu of that, granting permission to specific developers to remix this mod?

Feedback appreciated, thanks!

### Moonlight Lib Version

moonlight-1.19.2-2.3.6-forge

### Issue Detail

In the pack I have made, the interaction with a Supplementaries Faucet, and Pneumatic Craft Thermopneumatic Processing Plant allows for duplication of any fluid inside the Processing Plant, if a Faucet is attached to it. 

More details can be seen here from my original report: 
https://github.com/TeamPneumatic/pnc-repressurized/issues/1290


The dev of PNC suggests:

"This is absolutely a problem with the Faucet, which is misusing the forge IFluidHandler API. The faucet is extracting an arbitrary tank from the fluid handler it gets and extracting from that. The arbitrary tank is picks is tank 0, the input tank.

The correct way to do this is to call drain() directly on the fluid handler itself, not mess about with the tank internals."

issues.title: Support Third-Party Items For Painting Tooltip
issues.body: Currently the feature for showing paintings on painting item tooltips is only applied to `Items.PAINTING`. If you instead checked `instanceof HangingEntityItem` and `HangingEntityItem#type == EntityType.PAINTING` it would allow the feature to work with mods such as [Handcrafted](https://modrinth.com/mod/handcrafted) - you can find their Fancy Painting implementation [here](https://github.com/terrarium-earth/Handcrafted/blob/13456d7d47c6935f94b1e5927abd15d95d991b2e/common/src/main/java/earth/terrarium/handcrafted/common/items/CustomPaintingItem.java). The caveat is that `HangingEntityItem#type` is private, so would need an Accessor mixin or equivalent.

issues.title: [🐞]: Crash Upon Loading Map When Updating from 1.19.2 to 1.20.1
issues.body:
### Before Continuing:

- [X] Always check you are using the latest version of the mods and its dependencies
- [X] Remove mod that enhances Minecraft: Optifine, Sodium, others. The issue persists.
- [X] If you are unsure which mod is the culprit.
Disable all of your mods and enable them 1-2 mods each time to isolate the culprit
- [X] Confirm that there is no existing issue with a similar description submitted in the list of issues.

### Version

1.20.1-FORGE

### Supplementaries Version

supplementaries-1.20-2.7.33

### Moonlight Lib Version

moonlight-1.20-2.9.7

### Issue Detail

Hello, my client crashes on a server (server itself still runs) whenever I load a chunk with an alleged broken map. Looking at the crash report, Supplementaries showed up a decent amount. 

Removing the map solves the issue, and then happens again when I select it in my hotbar, or drop it on the ground. 
Removing Supplementaries solves the issue outright. 
Then when I look at it (re-rendering it), and add Supplementaries again, the issue is resolved.

I'm updating my pack from 1.19.2 to 1.20.1, so my guess is that there's some unsupported color on the map or something that just needs to be gracefully deleted upon updating.

FYI the linked crash report includes Quark, but I get the same issue without Quark enabled.

[crash-2024-02-06_23.06.57-client.txt](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/files/14188968/crash-2024-02-06_23.06.57-client.txt)

issues.title: [🐞]: Cage can be used to exploit goblin traders
issues.body:
### Before Continuing:

- [X] Always check you are using the latest version of the mods and its dependencies
- [X] Remove known problematic rendering mods such as Optifine, Sodium and others. Do NOT report issues related to said mods
- [X] If you are unsure which mod is the culprit.
Disable half your mods at time until you isolate the culprit
- [X] If you have a crash ALWAYS post LATEST.LOG below
- [X] If the issue is about behaviors be sure to consult the WIKI first

### Version-Loader

1.19.2-forge

### Supplementaries Version

supplementaries-1.19.2-2.4.11

### Moonlight Lib Version

moonlight-1.19.2-2.3.5

### Issue Detail

Not a bug, but I discovered an exploit that's made possible when you have a cage from Supplementaries, a goblin/fiery goblin from Goblin Traders, and a friend to do this with. This exploit allows you to bypass the max trade lock when trading with a goblin, resulting in a pretty op way of getting emeralds or good loot. 

### Optional Attachment

_No response_

### To Produce

(For this example, I will be using fiery goblins, and players A and B. Fiery goblins can trade you one emerald per carrot given with a max of around 24 I think.)
Player A has to right click on the fiery goblin to begin trading with it, and player B has to pick up the fiery goblin with their cage. Once the fiery goblin has been picked up, player A can trade the max amount of carrots and the trade will be locked off. Once player B places the fiery goblin on the ground again, the trade will not be locked off and they can redo the trades over and over. The same thing can be done with other trades.

issues.title: Using rope arrows to create instant rope-bridges
issues.body:
### Before continuing, do the following checklist:

- [X] Read the list of features via [Home](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/wiki)
- [X] Confirm there is no existing feature that meets your ideal feature
- [X] Confirm there is no existing submitted feature request in the issue

### Details

## Description: Currently, rope arrows are used to create instant, quickly-descendable "ladders"-- very useful in caves. However, I crave a similar use to create instant rope bridges across gaps.
My idea (the best way I can think of to implement such a feature) is that, when a rope arrow is held in the off-hand when shot, the player would still be holding the rope that is attached to the arrow (which is now lodged in a wall somewhere). Think of the connection between an entity and a lead attached to a block. The player may then right-click the side of a block, creating a rope bridge. Of course, the player would only be able to establish the connection on a block that is straight across from the target, and that is within the limits that rope can stretch out to in the air.

![2023-12-29_19 40 45](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/assets/71224403/f317699d-1953-4159-8be9-d1cc095dab56)
![2023-12-29_19 41 06](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/assets/71224403/d72d6589-4b0d-4e05-a389-f7095be3c559)
![2023-12-29_19 43 01](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/assets/71224403/716b9a36-131e-43a6-a0fa-f4cec5575fd7)
Very basic demonstration (without the rope in-hand attachment part, because I don't know how to do that).

## Why should we implement the feature?
C&U. Coolness and Utility.
Yeah, you could just bridge across with blocks, but why do that when you could do it _cooler?_

### Details

## Description:
Please set up a separate slot for the Quiver in the Curios API.
## Why should we implement the feature?
In this mod, the quiver occupies a slot in the backpack through the Curios API, conflicting with most backpack mods. However, I don't want to add more backpack slots, as this would lead to players carrying many backpacks, disrupting game balance! I hope you can set up a separate slot for the quiver. Thank you very much!

issues.title: [🐞]: [1.20.1] Mixin injecting SynchedEntityData into entities not owned by Supplementaries is dangerous
issues.body:
### Version-Loader

1.20.1-forge

### Issue Detail

Entity Data Accessors should only be ever set by the creator of the entity. Never added to by other mods.

The reason for this is because Entity Data Accessors are order dependent so if multiple mods tries to add these entity data accessors to mobs and on client, they run in a different order than the server did (because mod load order is not guaranteed), the client will get forcibly disconnected from server when the entity spawns.

Instead, this mixin part needs to be removed and migrated properly to a Forge Capability because capabilities were designed specifically for this use case of attaching data to arbitrary entities. It is safer for mods as the vanilla system is designed specifically only for vanilla and unsafe for mods. Then you would use your own packet to send the data to client when needed.

https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/blob/a4449f375ce719cca9a7fc1cf609f821e8dae3ea/common/src/main/java/net/mehvahdjukaar/supplementaries/mixins/SkeletonMixin.java#L32-L43

https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/blob/a4449f375ce719cca9a7fc1cf609f821e8dae3ea/common/src/main/java/net/mehvahdjukaar/supplementaries/mixins/StrayMixin.java#L29-L42

This is especially a problem in large modpacks where many mods are doing this. Example is TNPLimitless 7 where there's many mods injecting SynchedEntityData onto entities and are getting out of order due to mod load order. Which is causes a lot of reports of people getting disconnected from server due to: 
![image](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/assets/40846040/e34ec0ff-3a2f-4737-922b-f9c4a2e0c136)

issues.title: Allow other items with the over encumbrance tag to trigger the debuff on their own (Right now a sack is needed)
issues.body:
### Before continuing, do the following checklist:

- [X] Confirm there is no existing feature that meets your ideal feature
- [X] Confirm there is no existing submitted feature request in the issue

### Details

## Description:

The over encumbrance debuff is _exactly_ what I want to discourage players from using container items. I've installed the Sophisiticated Backpacks mod, and I've given all the backpacks the `overencumbering` tag. I can carry as many backpacks as I want, but if I pick up one filled sack _then_ I get the debuff. I would expect holding three backpacks to trigger the debuff on their own, if possible, just by having the tag.

## Why should we implement the feature?

This would _greatly_ increase the utility of the mod, and allow users (and mod makers) to easily make their custom items conform consistently to the genius container item penalty from Supplementaries.

issues.title: Config Request: Turn off horizontal ropes
issues.body:
### Before continuing, do the following checklist:

- [X] Read the list of features via [Home](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/wiki)
- [X] Confirm there is no existing feature that meets your ideal feature
- [X] Confirm there is no existing submitted feature request in the issue

### Details

## Description:

Add a config option to turn off the ability to extend ropes horizontally.

This is separate from the ability to place ropes next to walls, which leads to the following combinations:

- Ropes can be connected to walls, and extend horizontally
- Ropes can be connected to walls, but cannot be extended horizontally any further
- Ropes can only be connected to ceilings, but can extend horizontally after (not sure why you'd want this)
- Ropes can only be connected to ceilings, and can only extend downwards

## Why should we implement the feature?

I find that most of the time, when I'm placing horizontal ropes, I'm doing it accidentally, in a situation where it doesn't make sense (e.g. I'm repeatedly placing ropes downwards to go down a cave shaft, but when it reaches the end, it starts placing ropes sideways).

It's cool to be able to span ropes horizontally to navigate a chasm, but actually doing so is way more dangerous than just using blocks in your inventory, and doesn't feel realistic (or at least it feels way less realistic in comparison), so its primary use case is not useful.

issues.title: Storing signals with relayer
issues.body:
MC v 1.19.4 fabric 0.14.23 Mod v 2.4.15-fabric (moonlight 2.4.16-fabric)

I personally don't consider this a bug, but a feature. However, you are the developer, you decide what to be and what not.

We know that the relayer can't see the signal on a normal (full) block. But if the block is placed and gets a signal at the same time,
- the relayer will see that signal (strong or weak). And moreover - it saves it! You can turn off the signal on the block.

That state is inert to other signals, leaving the world or game. Also, is inert to other block updates around. But if you break the block or move it, or move a relayer, the stored signal is gone.

If the stored signal disappeared in 0-tic time, this might be more useful..... I have not been able to test this in game. I've tried it, but no success. But I got results from which I can tell that the relayer shuts down around 1-tick time. Always.

screenshots:
![supplem_relayer-cell_1](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/assets/111206434/cd1cb0a6-e5f4-49ad-9312-ff6be1f92219)
![supplem_relayer-cell_2](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/assets/111206434/2720dba2-25c5-45b0-b87f-e06efe21f36d)
![supplem_relayer-cell_3](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/assets/111206434/90925397-19e6-461d-8f70-a142cea0766d)
![supplem_relayer-cell_3-0](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/assets/111206434/990ffd41-ffcb-44aa-9df7-734f819057a3)
![supplem_relayer-cell_3](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/assets/111206434/b4d7f2dd-896d-403f-ba43-c07843f9296b)
![supplem_relayer-cell_5](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/assets/111206434/f50493b9-9629-4fcd-9eb3-ffcad53248de)
![supplem_relayer-cell_6](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/assets/111206434/16baf277-426a-4786-a638-8370ae9eba29)

It turns out that in order to catch a signal, relayer must see not only the signal, but also the block update. Normal blocks won't update from a signal unless they are placed, moved, or broken. And that's not a bug, is it?!

issues.title: Beautify's "glowstone essence lamp" incompatibility
issues.body:
Minecraft - 1.19.2
Fabric Loader - 0.14.22
Supplementaries - 1.19.2-2.3.24
Beautify: Refabricated - 1.1.1+fabric-1.19.2

I noticed Beautify's glowstone essence lamp would transform into a Supplementaries wall lantern only when placed on walls, but remained normal when placed on the floor or hung from above. Unfortunately, the lamp has special functionality and maintains NBT data - you can add 1, 2 or 3 glowstone into it that varies its brightness, plus it has special animations - which no longer function after being switched out.

The mod's source is available at [here](https://github.com/Suel-ki/Beautify-Refabricated) and this particular NBT tag is `beautify:lamp_jar`. I believe that can be added to the [wall lanterns blacklist](common/src/main/resources/data/supplementaries/tags/blocks/wall_lanterns_blacklist.json) to prevent the replacement? I'm not really much of a modder but I suspect I could augment that blacklist via my own datapack too. Thank you!

issues.title: [Request/suggestion] Mob capture Cage Expansion
issues.body:
You've got normal cage which seems to typically be useful for picking up small animals but can be configured to allow others and you've got the mechanic to allow mobs to only be picked up on a health threshold.
While being able to pick up all things is not survival friendly (as far as the config thinks) would it be a possible idea to expand upon this and allow 2-3 forms of cage?

The normal cage which can pick up small animals and mobs or baby animals and mobs without a limitation.
But also a "powerful" cage made with 3 normal cages as the bars and obsidian along it's bottom with a diamond and two gold on the top that produces a cage that renders much larger (would take up the space of maybe a 2x2x2 when placed on a block and the entity would render inside up to a certain size) which can capture bigger mob types.

Mobs who are large but passive/neutral or weakened large hostiles tagged as "cageable_large" or something of the sort. But then also mobs who are tagged as "cageable_powerful", basically for bosses and other powerful enemies who must have their health reduced by an amount to be viable to capture. 

Alternatively, smithing tabling a nether star onto a large cage can make it a master cage giving it a more crystaline and enchanted glow which now takes up 3x3x3, which has it's own configurable HP reduction amount which would be intended as a super capture for most if not all things. (or can be made to have a higher threshold for less frustration/straight up allow any capture)

Then you can let people have their small cage for original functionality. Large cage for the mobs and potentially bosses if configured and with the struggle, then the master enchanted cage for the "go nuts, catch and display overpowered things" tiered functionality for when they're approaching their end game. _(depending on what their end game is, people can of course just edit the recipe with datapack after the fact but the functionality would atleast be there)_

issues.title: Amount of fluid in Jars is inconsistent with other fluid containers
issues.body:
In Vanilla Minecraft, a Cauldron can hold 3 bottles of water, which equals one bucket. This means that bottles can hold 1/3 of the contents of a bucket.
However, jars in Supplementaries hold up to 12 Bottles, or 3 buckets. This means that 1 bottle can hold 1/4 of the contents of a bucket.
This leads to a (small) exploit where you can have a jar flowing into a cauldron to produce an infinite amount of water using a single bucket. (which, I mean, is already possible by using seagrass)
Also, the units used in the tooltip of a jar are mBtl, which I assume are millibottles, 1/1000 of a bottle, but the unit should just be bottles

issues.title: Conflict with Filled to the Brim
issues.body:
I am testing with Filled to the Brim (will be referring to it as FTTB) 1.2.5, Supplementaries 2.5.21, Fabric 0.86.1 for 1.20.1
FTTB: https://github.com/JacktheDevel0per/FilledToTheBrim

Here's the crash report: 
[crash-2023-07-27_04.06.53-client.txt](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/files/12181431/crash-2023-07-27_04.06.53-client.txt)

Context:
FTTB is made to allow shulker boxes to store empty shulker boxes inside them. It uses a datapack to determine what items are allowed to be stored when empty. Supplementaries has it's own shulker blacklist tag that interferes with this, but it can be remedied through datapack as well. The issue comes when the player attempts to add items to a Sack or Safe item.

Expected Behavior:
Empty shulker boxes are able to be placed inside shulker boxes. If added to the FTTB datapack tag, Safe and Sack items should also be allowed in shulker boxes provided they are empty as well. Shulker boxes with items inside should not allowed to be placed into shulker boxes, same goes for Sack and Safe items. When attempting to put empty shulker boxes into a sack or safe, nothing significant should happen. When attempting to put shulker boxes that have items in them into a sack or safe, nothing significant should happen.

What actually happens:
Nothing is able to be placed into a shulker box without modifying Supplementaries shulker blacklist tag. However, altering the tag does allow empty shulker boxes to be placed into a shulker box. If the Safe or Sack items are added to the FTTB tag, regardless of the shulker blacklist tag, they are unable to be placed into shulker boxes. The worst effect is that, regardless of tags, regardless of whether these containers have items, attempting to place _anything_ into a Sack or Safe, including regular items, results in a crash similar to the one linked. 

Additional notes:
Firstly, I believe FTTB is at fault entirely, as using Essential Addons with the Carpet mod also allows shulker recursion (although it does not discriminate based on empty containers) which will immediately cause all shulker, safe and sack items to be able to be placed into container items without even changing the shulker blacklist tag. I wrote an issue report to FTTB a while ago but the mod author has not responded. The issue can be found here: https://github.com/JacktheDevel0per/FilledToTheBrim/issues/1 but this report has more information anyways.

I'm writing this out here on the off chance there's something Supplementaries can do to mitigate the issue. I think the concept of being able to carry empty containers is more than reasonable so I was pretty excited for FTTB until I found this incompatibility.

issues.title: Feedback an error message when a Speaker face is blocked
issues.body:

issues.title: [1.19.2] Unexpected hotbar lockup with the Quiver and GUIs.
issues.body:
**Versions**
Supplementaries 2.3.19 for Minecraft 1.19.2. Loader is Forge 43.2.6.
_Forge 1.20.1 versions of Supplementaries may also have this issue but have not been tested for it._

**The Issue**
The hotbar locks up - preventing you from switching slots via the mouse wheel or number keys - if the _Quiver_ keybind is held while a GUI such the pause menu or inventory is opened, then released before closing the GUI.

**To Reproduce**
The simplest way to reproduce the issue is to hold the _Quiver_ keybind and open the pause menu, release the keybind, then close the pause menu. The hotbar will then be locked up. Upon pressing and releasing the _Quiver_ keybind again, the hotbar will unlock and work as expected. This method also works with all other GUIs in the game, included modded ones.

If the Quiver is in the inventory or a valid slot when performing the above sequence, the Quiver's selection GUI will stay up until the keybind is pressed and released again.

**Thoughts**
To me, it looks as though the keybind handler fails to recognize that the _Quiver_ key is not being held after closing an inventory, and doesn't properly update until the key is pressed again. There also appears to be no check for whether there is a Quiver in the inventory or a valid slot before locking the hotbar and running the Quiver slot selection code.

issues.title: Weird behavior with Harvest with ease
issues.body:
Hello, I am the developer of [Harvest with ease](https://github.com/Nyphet/harvest-with-ease).  
I recently received a report ([issue 23](https://github.com/Nyphet/harvest-with-ease/issues/23#issuecomment-1593818012)) of a weird bug that happens when trying to right-click harvest a flax crop.

In my mod the right-click harvest of a tall crop follows this procedure:
1. `Block#getDroppedStacks` is called on the clicked block to get the correct drops for the harvest
2. The base block of the crop is located and reverted to age 0, while the above block is broken

This works fine when the right-clicked crop is the bottom part of the flax crop. However when the upper half of the flax crop is right-clicked, despite it breaking and reverting the whole crop to age 0, no drops are given.  
By checking the result of `Block#getDroppedStacks` called on the clicked half, when it's the bottom one it correctly gives the proper drops, while when it's the upper one the list of drops is empty.

Do you happen to have any insight on why this may be happening?  
Thank you

issues.title: Config or tag to disable angering entities when caged
issues.body:
#14 suggested angering nearby mobs when caged. While this is a neat mechanic and probably fine in most cases, it would be useful if there were a way to disable it for specific mobs.

My specific use case: I run a Quilt server with a moderately large player count (15-20 online during peak). It's based around Hex Casting, so everyone wants villagers, which of course are quite laggy. I've asked my players to cage their villagers when they're not using them, but since caging villagers angers (and raises prices for) every nearby villager and iron golem, it's not really reasonable to expect them to do this.

issues.title: [1.19.2] Named sacks lose names when using Quark's Expanded Item Interactions feature
issues.body:
Forge version: 43.2.11
Supplementaries version: 2.3.10
Quark version: 3.4-400

When inserting an item into a named sack with Quark's Expanded Item Interactions feature (specifically using its Shulker Box Interaction option), the sack's name is removed. This happens whether you click the sack onto the item or the item onto the sack. Shulker boxes themselves, notably, do not have this problem. If Supplementaries Squared is present, the issue also affects colored sacks.

Tested with only Quark, Supplementaries, AutoRegLib, Moonlight Lib, and JEI enabled.

Steps to reproduce: 
1. Acquire a sack and initialize it, if you haven't already (you can't quick-insert items into sacks that haven't been initialized yet).
2. Rename the sack something super cool on an anvil. 
3. Right-click the sack with an item in your inventory, and observe as your super cool name has been replaced by the default "Sack".

(Sorry for posting this on the wrong repository the first time.)

issues.title: [1.18.2] Memory leak in CapturedMobCache
issues.body:
I discovered this on 1.18.2 with mod version 1.5.14 but it looks like 1.19 would also be affected based on the code. The entities created and stored by this class can retain a reference to the client world even after the player disconnects/changes dimension, which causes a memory leak.

In 1.18.2 the `PEDESTAL_CRYSTAL` field in particular never appears to be reset which causes a permanent leak of the first loaded world.

https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/blob/e78fa476a330be85d6edaf34a17fc76fc6337d7f/src/main/java/net/mehvahdjukaar/supplementaries/client/renderers/CapturedMobCache.java#L36-L40

A simple fix for these issues would be to reset this cache whenever the client world changes, or at least to change the world which the entity is in.

issues.title: Effect blacklist for skeletons with quivers
issues.body:
Currently, it seems that any (negative?) potion effect is fair game for skeletons that generate with quivers.

The problem is that some potion effects are much deadlier than others (or are otherwise undesirable).

It makes perfect sense for quivers to be able to *hold* any arrows, but it would be very welcome if skeletons could be prevented from using some - like, say, Ars Nouveau's Blasting effect, which is potentially an instant kill (especially with the short duration from tipped arrows). Either attached to this or as a separate option, perhaps it'd also be good to keep the dropped quiver from generating with particular potion effects in it.

issues.title: Configurable blacklist for individual potion effects on bamboo spikes
issues.body:
Right now, bamboo spikes can be tipped with any potion effect, with a config to only allow harmful or neutral potion effects. 
[Relevant code.](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/blob/fb7073e114a8a94f166c28098b840b40d81d510f/src/main/java/net/mehvahdjukaar/supplementaries/common/items/BambooSpikesTippedItem.java#L53-L60)
My suggestion is to have a more granular configurability with the ability to blacklist individual potion effects, rather than just 'all beneficial on/off', with no way to disable neutral/harmful potions. 

Ideally, this would be defined by some sort of tag rather than a config, so that other mods can disable their potion effects from being added to a spike.

The particular reason I'd like this feature is that I'm a mod dev, and the ability to apply potion effects from my mod to spikes has broken the intended progression somewhat by allowing some exploity-combos.

issues.title: Reloading eventually causes reloads to fail
issues.body:
I'm on the most recent supplementaries, moonlight, and 1.19.2 forge.

Relevant log:
[message.txt](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/files/10926895/message.txt)

I think I know the problem, but I'm not a java programmer so I could be wrong. It looks like every reload is calling `HourglassTimesManager.parse()`, which then reads some data from some file, which is then added to `HourglassTimesManager.DUSTS`. This is then sent as a packet to the client. What I assume is happening is that for whatever reason, the data added to `DUSTS` is hashing to a different value, causing it to grow every reload until it reaches the 1MB packet size limit. This also only happened when I updated supplementaries, and it looks like that file is new since the last update. Hopefully this helps!

issues.title: Pulley cannot unroll more than 1 Farmer's Delight Rope when block is hanging
issues.body:
Essentially, the Pulley block's compatibility with Farmer's Delight's rope is limited, in that while the pulley can wind up an arbitrary length of rope (and the block at the bottom) just like with Supplementaries' rope, but cannot unwind a length of more than 1 rope if there is a block hanging at the bottom.

Minecraft version: 1.19.2
Tested on Forge version 43.1.47 with mod version 2.2.34b and Forge version 43.2.3 with mod version 2.2.35t
Client: Curseforge standalone client

Steps to recreate:
1. Fill Pulley with Farmer's Delight rope.
2. Extend the rope using a Crank or turntable, to the point that it reaches a block.
3. Retract the rope (and block) fully using the same.
4. Attempt to extend the rope once more, which gets stuck.

Rope unwinds by itself with no issue:
![ropeunwind](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/78383477/211992580-2bb63289-adab-457f-abcb-0f04b12373a9.png)

Rope retracts with a block with no issue:
![roperetract](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/78383477/211992640-750a5540-5b20-49b3-8f29-a6297583d73f.png)

Rope cannot unwind fully when a block is attached.
![ropebug](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/78383477/211992543-e093d261-673e-4eae-9a0f-9bda4416c3fe.png)

Quark's rope has no such issue:
![quarkrope](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/78383477/211993075-d45f2f35-797b-48a7-903d-2474473907bc.png)

issues.title: Flax Models and Textures
issues.body:
### Not quite a Bug Report, not quite a Feature Request, but sort of halfway in-between.
The models and textures of the Wild Flax and Flax Crop blocks have always felt lacking to me, compared to the rest of the textures in the mod.

Wild Flax having a complex grid of planes unlike any other grass or flower in the vanilla game makes it stand out to me, where I believe it should be the opposite, it should blend into the surroundings to make it feel more at home, I would pitch making the model a regular cross shape like the other grass, and making the texture bulkier and more grass-like:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52741226/197657157-6631c7fc-334b-48e1-a6b3-f6d14d1898e0.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52741226/197657188-2dd7049b-9ce1-4549-9611-d92221b9edd9.png)
^ An example of my personal approach.

The Flax Crop is also inconsistent, being a cross shape with random offset like a naturally occurring flower, rather than the # shape like every other farmland crop.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52741226/197657684-41a85a93-d630-4e60-9ecb-c083b735ce7d.png)
How I would approach it myself, would be to make the plant multiple smaller stalks, similar to Wheat:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52741226/197658168-c7bb557f-746d-4f4e-b9d2-2509217fde98.png)

### This is all just my opinion on the only thing in the mod that bugs my needlessly picky brain.
### I love everything else you do!

          sconce, wall_sconce, and wall_latern replaced with glowstone

With the above changes, the crash does not occur (since these are now full blocks).
Flying around the structure with the above changes reveal that vines are being placed under wall_laterns and on the sides of rope and sconces.

issues.title: Question / Bug(?): Wall lantern feature disable / restore blockstate?
issues.body:
Hello, first of all, great mod!

Though I do have a (silly) question / problem.

Your mod includes a tweak to allow Lanterns on wall mounts, which with the added swinging effect really looks nice. But I have one small issue with it. When using standard lanterns, the Complementary Shader 4 provides a nice and soft bloom on these lanterns.

I've also used a mod called "Lanterns belong on walls" before trying out Supplementaries and it did as advertized allow me to put lanterns on walls without further issues.

But when I use Supplementaries, the light coming off wall mounted lamps provided by your mod (which seems to override the other one) is dimmer and lacks the bloom.

Of course I tried to use your config menu to disable all related features, like setting high priority off, using fast lanterns to exchange the animated entity with a fixed block. But nothing changes, it keeps using the supplementary provided model / texture. This version is dim and bloom-less compared to the vanilla lantern, probably because the shader doesn't recognize it.

Is there a way for me to prevent supplementaries entirely from changing the model or whatever parameter it is changing?

See the screenshots attached. First one shows wall lanterns placed before supplementaries was installed. Second screenshot shows lanterns that have been placed after the mod was added. Shader used is Complementary 4.6

issues.title: Suddenly Crashing
The "Caravan Lead", a new item from the wandering trader, as well as some tweaks to leads and chains.
issues.body:
The wandering trader may rarely have the Caravan Lead in stock, this item allows the player to chain multiple entities together, allowing them to form a caravan of connected mobs, with a configurable upper limit. Additionally, mobs with this lead attached to them always try to maintain a given distance from each other, to avoid bunching together in a chaotic mess. Also, this lead does not snap, but rather if a mob in the caravan gets stuck, it keeps the rest from going too far away from it. The caravan mobs will attempt to match each other's speed, so you don't have any slow animals being dragged in the dirt behind you.

This item could have massive implications for how players go about moving large amounts of items across long distances.

Chains can now be used as leads, and have a similar no-snapping function. Normal leads can have this behavior enabled via config, but it is turned off by default.

issues.title: [1.19 Fabric] Bricks not dealing damage or breaking glass
issues.body:

issues.title: Gunpowder trails no longer work in 1.19
issues.body:
Hello, big fan of this mod. Was testing out some features and found that gunpowder could now be placed as trails and lit in the world. The feature did not seem to work at all. I tried placing and lighting a trail connecting to TNT, flammable blocks such as wool/wood, and ignitable blocks such as campfires/candles. Nothing seemed to trigger upon the fuse reaching the destination. I'm fairly certain this feature used to function perfectly in 1.18, so I figured this might have been an issue transitioning into 1.19. The only other mods I used in this instance are JEI and World Edit. Also, not sure if this would affect anything, but I did make sure had doFireTick set to true.

Lastly, I was using the fabric version, and I see that the fabric alternative to this mod is not quite finished yet, so I wasn't sure if this feature was unfinished or rather buggy/not working correctly, but decided to post this either way just in case. Keep up the good work on this mod!

I suggest making an alternative way of putting out sconces, using a shovel.
This would make it way easier to put out several sconces at a time instead of having to painstakingly water bucket the sconces quickly so the water doesn't go everywhere and make a mess, since currently if you're not fast enough, the water spreads out and can make a mess by breaking other objects in the room such as carpets.

issues.title: Compatibility issue with quark in 1.18.1
issues.body:
While playing with quark and supplementaries together in 1.18.1, I found two compatibility issues that may or may not be related to this mod.

First, when the double door opening is enabled, right clicking the door with a stick will cause only one door to open. This issue doesn't seem to occur with any other item that I tested except sticks, so I assume that might be due to the fact that this mod allows sticks to be placed in the world.

Second, the xp bottling doesn't seem to be working with quark oddities' matrix enchantment table system. The matrix enchantment table uses a new block ID separated from the vanilla enchantment table, so I'm assuming that's why it's not working, but it would be nice if the xp bottling works with enchantment tables from other mods. Not sure what is the best way to achieve this, though.

issues.title: Compatibility issue - Supplementaries allows Locks (from Locks mod) to be bypassed by a stick
issues.body:
**(Minecraft 1.16.5, tested on Forge 36.2.19 and 36.2.20)**
Noticed this after installing the Locks mod into a modpack based on Crucial II. Managed to isolate it down to these two mods. Easily replicable:

1. Install Locks
2. Install Supplementaries (and Selene Lib)
3. Place any Lock on any Chest
4. Hold a Stick in hand and open the locked chest

This seems to only work if BOTH 
[tweaks.placeable_sticks] sticks = true _(in supplementaries-common.toml)_ AND
[initialization.blocks] stick = true _(in supplementaries-registry.toml)_
Setting either of these to false disables this issue entirely.

I have not tested what combination of settings will change this issue when it comes to client config vs. server config.
_EDIT:_ this issue also arises with the use of Blaze Rods and Books, leading me to believe it has something to do with how Supplementaries handles attempts to place Sticks, Blaze Rods and Books.

I'm posting this in the Locks page as well
https://github.com/Melonslise/Locks

issues.title: High TPS jitter on supplementaries-1.18.1-1.1.2
issues.body:
I run an "All The Mods 7" server and Supplementaries seems to be one of the mods in this pack. Recently, I've noticed some high jitter in the TPS on the server.

Version info:

Forge: 39.0.9
Minecraft: 1.18.1
Supplementaries: 1.1.2

Spark profile available here: https://spark.lucko.me/XKl7UbT7MW

Reading the trace, it seems that the cause of this issue is very similar to another one that I encountered with a different mod, tracked here: https://github.com/Ellpeck/NaturesAura/issues/235

I guess `level.getChunkSource()` takes a long time to run sometimes (maybe it's doing a disk read?), and that results in a very high TPS in those cases.

The patch that that mod-maker used is this: https://github.com/Ellpeck/NaturesAura/compare/13e6307921a741fd71ed1048151053bfd17579bf...87d080416da4308c1ed22f0518a3d027fdb137a8

issues.title: [bug] when bees fertilize flax, it sometimes pops the crop
issues.body:
forge 1.18.1-39.0.5, suplementaries-1.18-1.0.7.

ever since i brought bees home to my indoor farm, i started having my flax crops seemingly randomly get popped. it almost looked like trampling, except the farmland wasn't transformed to dirt. the problem was also restricted solely to my flax, even though i have alternating rows of carrots/flax for growth rate purposes.

eventually i managed to see it in action: a bee happened to fertilize flax, and the at the same time as the green particles showed up on the flax, the plant popped like it had gotten broken.

the one that i watched get popped happened to be fully grown. i've seen other flax be fertilized without trouble. so it seems to be connected to a bee fertilizing fully grown flax.

it'd be nice if we could dye sacks, to help distinguish between them (in case you own a bunch, and want to have specific ones for specific purposes)

issues.title: Suggestion / Feature Request: Bat Guano and Saltpeter
issues.body:
My suggestion is two things but they're related.

**Bat Guano:**

What is it? Bat Guano is bat poop. Guano also means bird or seal poop but those are different.

Where is it found? I think bat guano should spawn in caves as blocks and carpets and also be obtained from bats to give them some use. 

Is it renewable? The blocks would be kind of like gilded blackstone with a chance to drop a random amount of bat guano items also I think they should be uncraftable. That would not be renewable.  Another way to obtain bat guano could be from the bats laying the item like chickens lay an egg. I think ideally they'd only poop if players are nearby and maybe they should poop straight into jars and not poop otherwise. Guano would not have many uses so I don't think players should encounter it frequently apart from being decoration for caves. Also guano shouldn't appear when people don't want it that just makes bats more of a nuisance

Uses? Bat guano could maybe be used as a fertilizer like bonemeal as well as a main ingredient in Saltpeter

**Saltpeter:**

What is it? Saltpeter is Potassium Nitrate 

Where is it found? Saltpeter should be crafted from ash, bat guano, and water (cocoa beans are guano and sugar is saltpeter) The recipe would be shapeless
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/31190716/144920367-9f515a9e-16de-4695-8b18-2f2a9f1d0807.png)
Note: The water bucket doesn't need to be used up for this recipe. 

Is it renewable? Yes, but not easily and that's a good thing based on its crafting uses.

Uses? While it is used as a fertilizer also in real life that would be lame and bad to do especially if bat guano is also going to be a fertilizer. Therefore I think it's more fun to imagine saltpeter being used only in excess which in real life kills plants. Saltpeter could be used to kill grass, resulting in a dirt which cannot be taken over by mycelium or grass. This would be a way to have true dirt next to grass. Saltpeter could also be used to stop plant growth similar to how Quark uses poisonous potatoes to stop animal growth. That would be good for decoration. Finally, saltpeter would be used to craft gunpowder.

The recipe is 6 saltpeter, 2 charcoal, and 1 blaze powder (OreDictionary sulfur should also be used). This is very close to the 75% saltpeter, 15% charcoal dust, 10% sulfur dust recipe of actual gunpowder. The recipe should also be shapeless
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/31190716/144920911-eeebb0eb-3d07-44ec-b091-677da87faf20.png)

issues.title: Compat; Bypassing Forge Event callbacks
issues.body:
Greetings o7
We found a funky interaction:

Create subscribes to forge's interact events for in-world filter slots.
Supplementaries subscribes to the same event in order to handle the placeable sticks feature.

Its handler's high priority setting causes it to run first: <https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/blob/83126033b46e2c9d89eb769cf95ae486afb02812/src/main/java/net/mehvahdjukaar/supplementaries/events/ServerEvents.java#L46>
The sticks' placement feature skips interaction event handling by asking the blockstate for an action result directly <https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/Supplementaries/blob/83126033b46e2c9d89eb769cf95ae486afb02812/src/main/java/net/mehvahdjukaar/supplementaries/events/ItemSOverrideHandler.java#L415>

Therefore, if a block returns != pass, all modded interact handlers that do not claim 'highest' priorities are skipped.
Ultimately this means any item made placeable in new ways will not be accepted as filters on a handful of Create blocks such as the funnel.

My suggestion would be to consider the new placement options a low or lowest priority handler, as sneaking should bypass most interaction handlers added by other mods.
Feel free to ask if you need more details, or to close if you consider this a non-issue.

Cheers!

issues.title: The Pulley can retract any block
issues.body:
I'm using the Crucial 2 modpack, which includes version 0.15.2b of this mod.

The Pulley, when rotated the correct direction by a turntable, cam collect any block underneath it and store it inside itself, rather than only collecting chains and ropes. The internal inventory is then filled with the block in question, even though only chain or rope can be added by hand. Even normally unharvestable blocks like Bedrock and Spawners can be harvested this way.

The pulley seems to use the same logic to collect these blocks as it would a chain or rope -- it can even retract whole lines of them. Once there are blocks in its inventory, the pulley will also extend lines of these blocks.

After updating to the latest version of Supplementaries, I discovered that my game would just crash during startup. No crash report was generated so I was very confused as to what was causing it at first. 

After looking in the latest log (linked above) I found it was a conflict between Supplementaries and a mod called Two Players One Horse (Link to mod's page here: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/two-players-one-horse). Thanks for the amazing mod, You're always able to come up with great new features every update and I greatly appreciate it!
